manifest.title: Settings
manifest.summary: Configure networking, SSH sharing, serial console, keyboard vibration, power, and device settings.
manifest.description: The system Settings application for LILYGO UI devices, providing Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, Ethernet, cellular radio and SIM information with available modem data statistics, battery capacity calibration and charging limits, keyboard vibration, SSH remote login, serial console, and device information controls.

permissions.reason: Inspect networking; allow existing administrator users to join or forget Wi-Fi networks and toggle SSH through narrowly authorized system commands.
Inspect, enable, pair, and disconnect Bluetooth devices through BlueZ.

Access the nRF9151 cellular module through /dev/ttyACM0 to control LTE and read SIM, registration, signal, and available modem data statistics using the user's operating-system serial permissions; allow existing administrator users to save serial console settings and restart after confirmation through narrowly authorized commands.
Read fuel gauge telemetry and allow administrator users to calibrate BQ27220 capacities and set BQ25890 current limits through a restricted helper.
